# Suresh Kamrushi

> Personal portfolio and practical blog by Suresh Kamrushi, a project manager focused on shipping software. Articles cover software delivery, engineering, GitHub Pages, static-site publishing, and AI search visibility.

The site is published at [sforsuresh.in](https://sforsuresh.in). The blog index is available at [Blog](https://sforsuresh.in/blog/).

## About

- [Home](https://sforsuresh.in/): Portfolio and professional background.
- [Blog](https://sforsuresh.in/blog/): Article index covering software, teams, delivery, engineering, and practical web guides.
